scripts.test:integration: npx cucumber-js specs --require specs/support --require specs/steps --tags "@integration and not @rate-limit"
scripts.test:integration:pipeline: npx cucumber-js specs --require specs/support --require specs/steps --tags "@pipeline and not @live"
scripts.test:integration:pipeline:live: npx cucumber-js specs --require specs/support --require specs/steps --tags "@pipeline and @live"
scripts.test:integration:cope-e2e: npx cucumber-js specs --require specs/support --require specs/steps --tags "@cope and @live and not @ui and not @sas"
scripts.test:bdd:report: node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('reports', { recursive: true })" && npx cucumber-js specs --require specs/support --require specs/steps --tags "not @rate-limit" --format json:reports/cucumber-report.json && node scripts/generate-report.js
